name: Adamancipator Luminous
effectText:
2 Effect Monsters, including a Synchro Monster
If this card is Link Summoned, or a monster(s) is Special Summoned to a zone(s) this card points to: You can target 1 monster in your face-up field or GY; Special Summon 1 "Dwimmered Stone Token" (Rock/LIGHT/ATK 0/DEF 0) with the same Level as that monster. When an effect of another monster on the field is activated (Quick Effect): You can place that monster on top of the Deck. You can only use each effect of "Adamancipator Luminous" once per turn.
